QUOTE: `tests/scripts/components-configuration-crypto.sh` runs the `*constant_time*` suites under Valgrind memcheck, with `--track-origins=yes`. Memcheck flags branches on undefined data, which is how secret-dependence is detected.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer mentions valgrind-based testing of the constant-time suites. It never says the facility is off-by-default, separate from the library, or explicitly not part of the library API.
